column1: # Every place that asks a validator descriptor for a classical consensus key.
# A post-quantum descriptor has no such key and refuses rather than inventing one, so a
# site that is not guarded stops the node the moment PQ descriptors become authoritative.
# That is why Genesis activation waits for these to be converted, and why the inventory
# has to be a thing that fails rather than a paragraph someone remembers to update:
# adding a site, removing one, or converting one without saying so here fails the check.
#   guarded      a post-quantum descriptor cannot reach it
#   aborts-on-pq reachable with a post-quantum descriptor; must be converted before Genesis
